moonbloom_petal.name: Moonbloom Petal
moonbloom_petal.desc: Glows faintly when nobody is looking at it.

silverleaf.name: Silverleaf
silverleaf.desc: Leaves that ring like tiny bells when shaken.

dewmint.name: Dewmint
dewmint.desc: Always damp, even in a drought.

whisperwort.name: Whisperwort
whisperwort.desc: Hold it to your ear and it repeats the last thing said nearby.

starthistle.name: Starthistle
starthistle.desc: Its spines point north at night.

hushroot.name: Hushroot
hushroot.desc: Muffles every sound around it for a heartbeat.

emberleaf.name: Emberleaf
emberleaf.desc: Warm to the touch, like it remembers summer.

thornsalt.name: Thornsalt
thornsalt.desc: Crystals scraped from the old rose thorns.

fairy_ring_cap.name: Fairy-Ring Cap
fairy_ring_cap.desc: Grows in circles. Never step inside the circle.

glowshroom.name: Glowshroom
glowshroom.desc: A soft blue lantern that sprouted from the dark.

inkcap.name: Weeping Inkcap
inkcap.desc: Drips ink that writes on its own if you leave it.

hollow_morel.name: Hollow Morel
hollow_morel.desc: Blow through it and it plays one note, always the same one.

cracked_crystal.name: Cracked Crystal
cracked_crystal.desc: Something inside it moved once. Probably.

moonstone_chip.name: Moonstone Chip
moonstone_chip.desc: Cold at noon, warm at midnight.

dew_diamond.name: Dew Diamond
dew_diamond.desc: A single drop of morning dew that refused to fall.

tree_amber.name: Heart-Amber
tree_amber.desc: Sap from the Ancient Tree. There's something tiny caught inside.

black_rose.name: Black Rose
black_rose.desc: Only blooms when every other flower goes dark.

veil_lily.name: Veil Lily
veil_lily.desc: Its petals are see-through if you squint.

ghost_orchid.name: Ghost Orchid
ghost_orchid.desc: Appears in your hand. You don't remember picking it.

starseed.name: Starseed
starseed.desc: Planted, it would grow toward the stars instead of the sun.

moth_dust.name: Moth Dust
moth_dust.desc: Silver powder from a moon moth's wings.

sprite_thread.name: Sprite Thread
sprite_thread.desc: Finer than hair, stronger than rope.

frog_gold.name: Golden Frog Scale
frog_gold.desc: Worth a fortune to the right frog.

owl_feather.name: Barn-Owl Feather
owl_feather.desc: Makes no sound at all when it falls.

phoenix_down.name: Phoenix Down
phoenix_down.desc: Nobody has seen a phoenix in the Garden. Nobody.

snail_pearl.name: Snail Pearl
snail_pearl.desc: The snail was very reluctant to give this up.

unknown_husk.name: Unidentified Husk
unknown_husk.desc: Whatever wore this is bigger now.

pressed_letter.name: Pressed Letter
pressed_letter.desc: A love letter pressed flat in an old book. The names are smudged.

pool_water.name: Vial of Pool Water
pool_water.desc: Your reflection in it is a second late.

tree_bark.name: Heartwood Bark
tree_bark.desc: Still has a pulse, if you listen.

map_scrap.name: Map Scrap
map_scrap.desc: Shows a path in the Garden nobody has walked.

prophecy_leaf.name: Prophecy Leaf
prophecy_leaf.desc: There are words in the veins. They change.

overdue_slip.name: Overdue Slip
overdue_slip.desc: A notice for a book that was due back before you were born.

marginalia_scrap.name: Marginalia Scrap
marginalia_scrap.desc: A torn page corner, scribbled with someone else's homework answers.

pressed_violet.name: Pressed Violet
pressed_violet.desc: Found between two pages of something nobody's checked out in years.

dust_of_forgotten_words.name: Dust of Forgotten Words
dust_of_forgotten_words.desc: Swept from a shelf nobody dusts. Smells like old paper.

inkmoth_wing.name: Inkmoth Wing
inkmoth_wing.desc: Feeds on spilled ink instead of light. Still faintly warm.

self_inking_nib.name: Self-Inking Nib
self_inking_nib.desc: Writes on its own if you're not paying attention.

memory_bookmark.name: Memory Bookmark
memory_bookmark.desc: Remembers the last page you meant to return to, even if you don't.

locked_diary.name: Locked Diary
locked_diary.desc: It won't open for you. It won't open for anyone, probably.

rusted_key.name: Rusted Key
rusted_key.desc: Fits a lock that isn't here anymore.

manacle_link.name: Manacle Link
manacle_link.desc: A single link, worn smooth by something that pulled at it for a long time.

cellar_moss.name: Cellar Moss
cellar_moss.desc: Glows faintly green in the dark. Cold to the touch.

dead_currency_coin.name: Dead Currency Coin
dead_currency_coin.desc: A coin from a kingdom that doesn't exist anymore.

chalk_of_shadows.name: Chalk of Shadows
chalk_of_shadows.desc: Only writes where the light doesn't reach.

shackle_dust.name: Shackle Dust
shackle_dust.desc: Scraped from a cell wall. Something was counting the days here.

forgotten_shrine_ash.name: Forgotten Shrine Ash
forgotten_shrine_ash.desc: Cold ash from an altar nobody remembers building.

star_chart_fragment.name: Star Chart Fragment
star_chart_fragment.desc: A torn corner of a chart, pointing at nothing you recognize.

broken_compass.name: Broken Compass
broken_compass.desc: Every needle it's ever had points somewhere different.

orrery_gear.name: Orrery Gear
orrery_gear.desc: A single brass gear from a model of the sky that no longer turns.

moonglass_lens.name: Moonglass Lens
moonglass_lens.desc: Looking through it, the stars seem a little closer.

comet_dust_vial.name: Comet Dust Vial
comet_dust_vial.desc: Collected mid-fall. Nobody's quite sure how.

stardust_ledger_page.name: Stardust Ledger Page
stardust_ledger_page.desc: A page of handwritten star positions that don't match any known sky.

raven_feather.name: Raven Feather
raven_feather.desc: Still faintly warm. The raven that dropped it was watching you.

blackened_acorn.name: Blackened Acorn
blackened_acorn.desc: Never sprouted. Never will. Still, something planted it here on purpose.

standing_stone_chip.name: Standing Stone Chip
standing_stone_chip.desc: A flake from one of the stones nobody remembers arranging.

shed_fang.name: Shed Fang
shed_fang.desc: Long, curved, and definitely not from anything you'd want to meet.

root_charm.name: Root Charm
root_charm.desc: A knot of roots tied by hand - or something with hands.

witchlight_oil.name: Witchlight Oil
witchlight_oil.desc: Burns with a cold blue flame that casts no heat.

moss_of_silence.name: Moss of Silence
moss_of_silence.desc: Sound doesn't seem to travel near it.
